metadata.title: Global nonsolvability of the leafwise $\dbar$-equation on foliations with Stein leaves
metadata.abstract: Motivated by our previous work on $q$-convexity and global solvability for Levi flat structures, we study the complex foliation associated with the non-tame family of Stein structures constructed by Forstneri\v c and Sigurðardóttir. Although every leaf is closed and biholomorphic to $\C^2$ and the foliation admits a complete bundle-like Riemannian metric, there exists a smooth leafwise $\dbar$-closed $(0,1)$-form for which the leafwise $\dbar$-equation admits no global $L^r_{\loc}$ solution for any $0<r\le\infty$. This result also suggests a modification of Questions~2.10.4--2.10.6 in \emph{Foliations: Dynamics, Geometry and Topology}.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Stein 叶上的逐叶 ∂̄ 方程全局不可解
analysis.workSummary: 在 Forstnerič–Sigurðardóttir 的非 tame Stein 结构族产生的复叶状结构上，每片叶闭且双全纯于 ℂ²，整体还承载完备 bundle-like 黎曼度量，却存在光滑逐叶 ∂̄ 闭 (0,1) 形式，对任何 0<r≤∞ 均无全局 Lʳ_loc 逐叶解。
techniques: 非 tame Stein 结构族
analysis.breakthrough: 给出逐叶优良复几何与全局逐叶可解性之间的障碍，并促使修订既有问题。
analysis.limitations: 反例是叶状空间上的全局逐叶方程。单片叶与参数族的解不构成相同问题。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文10页与候选元数据的标准及补充检索未见作者自身使用 AI 的披露。第9页声明记录研究资助和利益冲突。

analysis.priorityReason: 复分析与叶状几何中的明确全局不可解现象。
